tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: High-emphasis fills: filled buttons, FAB icon, active indicators, selected controls, focus on text fields. As text, on surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis fills that still belong to the brand: FAB, tonal highlights, selected cards.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Less prominent accents: secondary text links, the focus indicator, filter-chip outlines.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, selected chips, the active pill in navigation bar and rail, selected segmented buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Contrasting accent that balances the green: highlights, data emphasis, a third FAB colour. As text, on surface.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tertiary fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Soft accent fills: info callouts, tertiary FAB, tags.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors only: invalid fields, destructive actions, the error badge. As text, on surface.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an error fill (badges, destructive filled buttons).

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners and callouts.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page and component background.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, unselected icons, field labels and supporting text, on surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: The dimmest surface; stays darkest in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: The brightest surface; stays lightest in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest-emphasis container, below surface (e.g. cards on a tinted page).

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Elevated cards, elevated buttons, modal sheets.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Navigation bar, navigation rail, menus.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs, search bar, date pickers.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Filled text fields, filled cards, switch track (off), progress tracks.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of surface-container-highest; prefer the container roles.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Legacy page background, same as surface; prefer surface.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Legacy text on background; prefer on-surface.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Important boundaries: text field and outlined-button borders, checkbox and radio rings. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative boundaries: dividers, outlined cards, chip borders. Not for meaningful borders.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbars and plain tooltips: the inverted surface.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Actions on inverse-surface (the snackbar button).

tokens.name: primary-fixed
tokens.usage: A primary fill that keeps the same tone in light and dark.

tokens.name: primary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: A deeper primary-fixed, for emphasis next to it.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on primary-fixed or primary-fixed-dim.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis text on primary-fixed.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: A secondary fill that keeps its tone in both themes.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: A deeper secondary-fixed.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on secondary-fixed or secondary-fixed-dim.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis text on secondary-fixed.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: A tertiary fill that keeps its tone in both themes.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: A deeper tertiary-fixed.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary-fixed or tertiary-fixed-dim.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis text on tertiary-fixed.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Tint colour for tonal elevation (legacy); equals primary.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow colour for elevation.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modal dialogs and sheets, used at 32% opacity.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success: completed runs, healthy sensors, confirmed saves. Always with the check-circle icon and text, because it sits close to the brand green. As text and icons on surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a success fill.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Low-contrast success notifications and tags.

tokens.name: on-success-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success-container.

tokens.name: inverse-success
tokens.usage: The success icon on inverse-surface (high-contrast notifications).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning: readings drifting out of range, actions that need care. Always with the warning icon. As text and icons on surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a warning fill.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Low-contrast warning notifications and tags.

tokens.name: on-warning-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-container.

tokens.name: inverse-warning
tokens.usage: The warning icon on inverse-surface (high-contrast notifications).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information: neutral system messages and tips. Always with the info icon. As text and icons on surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a info fill.

tokens.name: info-container
tokens.usage: Low-contrast info notifications and tags.

tokens.name: on-info-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on info-container.

tokens.name: inverse-info
tokens.usage: The info icon on inverse-surface (high-contrast notifications).

tokens.name: inverse-error
tokens.usage: The error icon on inverse-surface (high-contrast notifications).

tokens.name: layer-01
tokens.usage: Carbon layer 1: the first layer on the page. Tiles, data table rows, accordion panels, side nav. Same value as `surface-container-low`.

tokens.name: layer-02
tokens.usage: Carbon layer 2: a layer on layer-01 (a tile inside a tile, a table toolbar). Same value as `surface-container`.

tokens.name: layer-03
tokens.usage: Carbon layer 3: the top nested layer; also menus and the toast. Same value as `surface-container-high`.

tokens.name: layer-accent
tokens.usage: Accent layer: data table header row, the selected content-switcher track. Same value as `surface-container-highest`.

tokens.name: field-01
tokens.usage: Field fill on surface and layer-01. Same value as `surface-container-highest`.

tokens.name: field-02
tokens.usage: Field fill on layer-02 and layer-03, so the field still reads as a separate box. Same value as `surface-container-lowest`.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between rows, tiles and table cells. Same value as `outline-variant`.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The bottom line of fields, checkbox and radio rings: borders that carry meaning (3:1). Same value as `outline`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus indicator: a 2px line inside the component (Carbon), in the cool tertiary hue so it never reads as selection or brand.

tokens.name: focus-inset
tokens.usage: The 1px gap drawn inside the focus line on filled controls, so focus stays visible on primary and inverse fills.

tokens.name: link-primary
tokens.usage: Link text on surface and layers.

tokens.name: link-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Link text on hover.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links, where telling visited from new matters (docs, search results).

tokens.name: skeleton-background
tokens.usage: Skeleton placeholder blocks while content loads. Same value as `surface-container-high`.

tokens.name: skeleton-element
tokens.usage: The shimmer and fine lines inside skeleton placeholders. Same value as `outline-variant`.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: M3 display sizes in Plex Sans Light, the weight Carbon uses for its largest type.

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Hero numerals and one-line statements on large screens.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Hero numbers on compact screens and dashboard summaries.

groups.name: Headline
groups.note: Page and dialog headlines. Sizes match both M3 headlines and Carbon headings 04–05.

styles.name: headline-medium
styles.usage: Page headlines; dialog headlines on large screens.

groups.name: Title
groups.note: Headings inside components. The small titles take Carbon's SemiBold compact headings.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: App bar and shell titles, large tile titles (Carbon heading-03).

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Card and tile titles, data table titles, dialog section headers.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Small titles, accordion headings, notification titles, table column headers.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Running text, on Carbon's body metrics.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Drip lines in Zone B4 run for 12 minutes every morning. Moisture readings refresh every 5 minutes.
styles.usage: Long-form reading and text field input at the large size.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.sample: Readings are averaged across every sensor in the zone.
styles.usage: Default body text, table cells, dialog body, tile text.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Helper text under fields, captions, timestamps.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Field labels above inputs (Carbon label-01), navigation labels, tags.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Badge counts and short status words.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for code, IDs and machine values.

styles.name: code-01
styles.usage: Inline code, IDs in tables, sensor keys.

styles.name: code-02
styles.usage: Code snippets and token names in documentation.

spacing.note: Verdant's 4px steps extended with Carbon's 2px and large layout steps. Carbon names in brackets.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Flush items; condensed grids.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: [spacing-01] Hairline offsets: icon nudges, tag inner gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: [spacing-02] Tight gaps: icon to badge, label to field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: [spacing-03] Icon-to-label gap in buttons and chips; gap between tags and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: [spacing-04] Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding at large size.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: [spacing-05] Default inner padding: tiles, table cells, notification and field padding; compact margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a dialog icon, headline and body (M3).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: [spacing-06] Medium margin; dialog padding; gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: [spacing-07] Grid gutter; gap between content groups; the trailing room in a productive button.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: [spacing-08] Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: [spacing-09] Page-level separation; tall row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: [spacing-10] Large section breaks on expanded windows.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: [spacing-11] Hero and landing spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: [spacing-12] Landing page bands.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: [spacing-13] The largest layout step: hero bands on large windows.

size.note: Carbon's component heights. Pick one size per region and keep it.

tokens.name: size-xs
tokens.usage: Extra-small table rows, small tags.

tokens.name: size-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and fields, chips, dense table rows, header actions inside toolbars.

tokens.name: size-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, fields, select, icon buttons, accordion rows (M3's 40px and Carbon's medium agree here).

tokens.name: size-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons and fields, default table rows, the shell header, touch targets.

tokens.name: size-xl
tokens.usage: Extra-large buttons and table rows; the medium top app bar row.

tokens.name: size-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero buttons; the navigation bar.

radius.note: The M3 shape scale, squared toward Carbon. Content and inputs are crisp; only status and selection pills stay round.

tokens.name: shape-corner-none
tokens.usage: Tiles, data tables, fields (filled and stacked), search, shell header, side nav, tabs, notifications.

tokens.name: shape-corner-extra-small
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, segmented buttons, outlined fields, checkboxes, tooltips, snackbars.

tokens.name: shape-corner-small
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the small FAB, navigation indicators.

tokens.name: shape-corner-medium
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the FAB.

tokens.name: shape-corner-large
tokens.usage: The large FAB, side sheets.

tokens.name: shape-corner-extra-large
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners). Rare: use only for large floating surfaces.

tokens.name: shape-corner-full
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, badges, switches, slider handles, progress tracks, radio buttons.

shadow.note: M3 elevation levels, used the Carbon way: flat first. Only menus, dialogs, snackbars, toasts and FABs cast a shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Everything at rest: tiles, cards (filled and outlined), tables, buttons.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Elevated cards and buttons only.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdown lists, scrolled top app bar.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: FAB, dialogs, snackbars and toast notifications.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: FAB on hover.

tokens.name: elevation-5
tokens.usage: Reserved.

opacity.note: M3 state layers and disabled states: the content colour at this opacity, laid over the container.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state layer (rows, tiles, buttons, menu items).

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus state layer, under the focus line.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state layer.

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: Dragged state layer.

tokens.name: disabled-container
tokens.usage: Disabled containers: on-surface at this opacity.

tokens.name: disabled-content
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons: on-surface at this opacity.

tokens.name: scrim-opacity
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs (Carbon's overlay is heavier than M3's 32%).

breakpoint.note: M3 window size classes; the Carbon column grid runs inside them.

tokens.name: window-compact
tokens.usage: Phones (0–599px): navigation bar, 4-column grid, 16px margins.

tokens.name: window-medium
tokens.usage: Tablets in portrait (600–839px): navigation rail, 8-column grid, 24px margins.

tokens.name: window-expanded
tokens.usage: Tablets in landscape, small desktop (840–1199px): rail or side nav, 8-column grid, two panes.

tokens.name: window-large
tokens.usage: Desktop (1200–1599px): shell header with side nav, 16-column grid.

tokens.name: window-extra-large
tokens.usage: Wide desktop (1600px and up): cap content at 1584px (Carbon max).

grid.note: Carbon's 2x grid: column counts by window class, and three gutter modes.

tokens.name: grid-columns-compact
tokens.usage: Columns below 600px.

tokens.name: grid-columns-medium
tokens.usage: Columns from 600px to 1199px.

tokens.name: grid-columns-large
tokens.usage: Columns from 1200px.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Wide gutter (default): 16px each side of a column. Text-led layouts.

tokens.name: grid-gutter-narrow
tokens.usage: Narrow gutter: content hangs 16px into the gutter. Dense dashboards.

tokens.name: grid-gutter-condensed
tokens.usage: Condensed gutter: tiles separated by a 1px line, like a data wall.

tokens.name: grid-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on wide windows.

sound.note: The uisfx Zen pack: pure tones, dry wood and washi paper. Each token maps a component event to a Zen cue; bundle.js reads them from tokens.css, so set one to another cue name or none to change it. Sound repeats what is on screen, never replaces it.

tokens.name: sound-pack
tokens.usage: The uisfx pack every cue is played in. Zen is the house sound; the other eleven packs are not part of Leafy.

tokens.name: sound-volume
tokens.usage: Starting master volume (0 to 1) for people who have never moved the volume in SoundSettings. Their own setting wins after that.

tokens.name: sound-max-voices
tokens.usage: Most sounds at once. A fifth sound replaces the oldest, so bursts never pile up into noise.

tokens.name: sound-toggle-on
tokens.usage: Switch turned on; IconButton toggle selected.

tokens.name: sound-toggle-off
tokens.usage: Switch turned off; IconButton toggle cleared.

tokens.name: sound-check
tokens.usage: Checkbox checked.

tokens.name: sound-uncheck
tokens.usage: Checkbox cleared.

tokens.name: sound-select
